reviewDimensions: Actual role duties and seniority plausibly match candidate evidence
Candidate's expressed next scope and preferences are honored
Employer screening fit is grounded in explicit JD qualifications
Explicit candidate hard constraints are distinguished from soft preferences
Missing information is not invented as either a match or a contradiction
Higher-ranked opportunities offer more defensible value than displaced ones
reviewMethod: Read frozen evidence before assigning better/tie/uncertain, record cited fields and disagreements; assistant observations are not human labels.
releaseGate: No production model switch from this pilot alone. Independent human review and broader coverage are required.
